definitions.explanation: A sign indicating that a machine or facility is not working and cannot be used.

examples.japanese: エレベーターは{故障中|こしょうちゅう}です。
examples.english: The elevator is out of order.

examples.japanese: {故障中|こしょうちゅう}の{張|は}り{紙|がみ}がある。
examples.english: There is an 'out of order' sign.

examples.japanese: この{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}は{故障中|こしょうちゅう}なので、{隣|となり}のを{使|つか}ってください。
examples.english: This vending machine is out of order, so please use the one next to it.

notes:
{故障中|こしょうちゅう} combines {故障|こしょう} (breakdown, malfunction) + {中|ちゅう} (during, in progress). A sign expression indicating equipment or facilities are broken and unavailable.

USAGE:
You'll see this posted on:
- {自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}: vending machines
- エレベーター/エスカレーター: elevators/escalators
- トイレ: toilets/restrooms
- コピー{機|き}: copy machines

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {故障中|こしょうちゅう}の{張|は}り{紙|がみ}: "out of order" sign
- {故障中|こしょうちゅう}につき{使用|しよう}できません: cannot be used due to malfunction

SIMILAR 〜{中|ちゅう} EXPRESSIONS:
- {使用中|しようちゅう}: in use
- {点検中|てんけんちゅう}: under inspection
- {準備中|じゅんびちゅう}: in preparation / closed (at restaurants)
- {工事中|こうじちゅう}: under construction
